description: Calculates how much of another currency a USD amount buys at Futuur's latest exchange rates. It only calculates; nothing is exchanged and no balance changes. Use it to express a USD amount in USDC, USDT, EUR, BTC, ETH and other quoted currencies (see get_exchange_rates for the list). Play money (OOM) has no USD rate. Returns the converted amount, the rate used (units of the target currency per 1 USD) and when the rates were updated.

value.description: Amount in USD to convert, greater than 0.

name: convert_from_usd
title: Convert USD to another currency
